purpose: Exercise the implemented QRS control plane with a four-task fresh Primitive-H0 bank, one cross-family workflow_global proposal, mandatory exact-candidate answer-free Review, conditional matched parent/candidate gate, and answer-free curriculum handoff. Stop after panel 1; do not reuse its candidate or histories in main.

public_task_partition_rule.main_experiment_membership: No canary Worker, candidate, trajectory, claim inventory, or decision is reusable by main.

cross_family_workflow_evidence.canary_panel_1_visible_rule: The complete fresh holdings H0 trajectory plus one frozen fresh H0 anchor from derivatives and rates. No official outcome, diagnostic, prior candidate, or sealed identity enters Evolver evidence.

phase1_six_panel_curriculum.promotion_rule: The same focus-plus-other-family-anchor repeated task-reward gate as main. A scientific non-promotion is valid and still exercises the carry path; integrity, protocol, accounting, or boundary failures stop the canary.

required_live_outcomes.pass_side: At least one admitted candidate receives overall Review PASS with coverage PASS, is copied to the exact reviewed snapshot, passes the QRS mutation boundary, and is dispatched unchanged to both matched repetitions.
required_live_outcomes.answer_boundary: Review input contains the complete cumulative Primitive-H0-to-candidate Worker-visible material and trusted public contracts only; optimize_only_sources is empty; Review output and official fitness never enter Worker material.
required_live_outcomes.resume: A zero-work resume preserves the same state, cost, reviewed snapshot, and child results.
required_live_outcomes.handoff: Promotion appends only candidate answer-free traces and clean accepted claims; non-promotion carries only earlier accepted history. No official score or Reviewer reasoning enters the next evidence root.
required_live_outcomes.terminal: MINI_SCHEDULER_PASS only if all applicable P0 invariants pass. A legal proposal ABSTAIN or Review non-PASS is informative but does not satisfy the required live PASS-to-blind-Worker gate; freeze a separate recovery rather than launching main.

answer_boundary: All four H0 Workers and any candidate Workers are blind to scores, verifier output, failed properties, expected values, optimization diagnostics, Review artifacts, and prior contaminated candidates.
claim_boundary: This canary validates bounded execution, isolation, Review, matched dispatch, history handoff, accounting, and resume. It is not a main result, benchmark gain, reusable candidate, stable promotion, sealed result, or evidence for QRS effectiveness.
